opportunities.name: Four-hit self-stunner
opportunities.objective: Test four-hit self-stunner against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Concussive Blows needs four stacks, with Q providing one; Hail of Blades and attack items test finishing the stun without allied attacks. Blade adds physical on-hit while the passive's post-stun magic attack damage and Terminus supply mixed pressure.
opportunities.requiredState: Q lands and Braum reaches three quick ordinary attacks.
opportunities.failure: The target becomes stack-immune after stun, sharply limiting repeat control.
opportunities.test: Record time to stun and damage during the subsequent immunity window.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Rageblade phantom hits must not be assumed to add Concussive stacks.

opportunities.name: Health spear peel
opportunities.objective: Test health spear peel against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Winter's Bite adds 2.5% of source Stat(12) as magic damage, suggesting health stacking for poke and defense; Heartsteel must be earned in melee. Bandlepipes triggers from Q slow or passive stun and grants nearby attack speed, helping allies complete Concussive Blows.
opportunities.requiredState: Stay near allies and alternate Q poke with safe Heartsteel attacks.
opportunities.failure: Health without enough resistances fails against percent-health damage.
opportunities.test: Compare Q damage and allied stun completion at recorded Heartsteel stacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The Q stat ID is not a verified formula mapping, and E only blocks the first missile completely.

ruledOut.reason: Rageblade phantom hits must not be assumed to add Concussive stacks.

unknowns: Item and ability proc attribution requires a controlled current-patch test; symbolic statFormula and source flags are not runtime verification.

builds.name: Four-hit self-stunner
builds.summary: Test four-hit self-stunner against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test four-hit self-stunner against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Concussive Blows needs four stacks, with Q providing one; Hail of Blades and attack items test finishing the stun without allied attacks. Blade adds physical on-hit while the passive's post-stun magic attack damage and Terminus supply mixed pressure.
testPlan: Required state: Q lands and Braum reaches three quick ordinary attacks.
Record time to stun and damage during the subsequent immunity window.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: The target becomes stack-immune after stun, sharply limiting repeat control.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Rageblade phantom hits must not be assumed to add Concussive stacks.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blade of The Ruined King, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Titanic Hydra, Spirit Visage, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Braum raises his shield for [3 / 3.25 / 3.5 / 3.75 / 4] seconds, intercepting enemy missiles from the chosen direction, causing them to hit Braum and then be destroyed. The first missile Braum blocks deals no damage, and subsequent projectiles deal [35 / 40 / 45 / 50 / 55]% reduced damage.

Braum propels freezing ice from his shield, dealing [75 / 120 / 165 / 210 / 255 + (0.025) × Stat(12)] magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slowing them by [70]% decaying over [2] seconds.

Applies a stack of Concussive Blows.
